BL-1372 — The babysitter sweep's invariant-two assertion greps for any ancestry call at all, so a legitimate main-sync merge-base fails an invariant that is intact - the same defect BL-1314 already fixed for handoffd.bb
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 by the specifier from an architect priority-00 note on the
BL-1359 pass, which surfaced two pre-existing untracked reds rather than
dropping them. The architect grepped `backlog/` for both before reporting and
confirmed neither had a ticket.
Approval context: No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options, because you already ruled on this exact question. BL-1314 offered you the two readings - narrow the assertion, or keep it strict and refactor the code it flags - and you chose option 1, "scope the assertion to the QA question, leave handoffd.bb al…
BL-1372 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1372" (or "reject BL-1372 <reason>") to act.
